content.data: I have been working with Shopify since 2009, shortly after the platform’s launch, building a solid foundation of knowledge across its entire ecosystem.
Over the years, I have developed fully custom themes from scratch as well as extensively customized existing themes to meet specific business needs.
Advanced theme customization for unique business requirements.
Custom app creation and third-party integrations.
Beyond themes, I have created new sections and components to enhance existing stores, built custom Shopify apps, and integrated external services through APIs and webhooks.
I also have hands-on experience with Hydrogen for headless storefronts, combining Shopify Storefront API with modern frameworks to deliver fast and flexible user experiences.
Headless storefront development with Hydrogen v2 (Remix).
Modern React/TypeScript workflows with a strong emphasis on typed APIs, DX, and measurable outcomes (A11y, SEO, analytics quality).
